rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and only acted on that user's account. They looked up orders, correctly identified the two tablets, and asked which one to return and where to refund. Before making any change, the agent summarized the exact action and requested explicit confirmation. When the user changed their mind, the agent restated the updated plan and again asked for confirmation. After receiving a clear “yes,” the agent executed the return on the correct order and item ID, selected the specified gift card for the refund, and the tool reflected the updated status to “return requested.” Final information given to the user matched the tool results. No unsupported claims or policy violations observed.
